messages:
maya: FYI samplekit CI started flaking after the latest typegen regen on main. Seeing intermittent auth/retry failures plus regendiff noise.
raul: Which tests are failing? Can you paste the CI snippet?
maya: auth-backoff.unit.ts and auth-integration.spec. Fail looks like 502 Bad Gateway from the test harness.
tanya: Any obvious changes in the generated client? Parameter order or helper names sometimes trip stuff.
maya: regen-bot posted a short diff: it reordered ClientOptions fields and renamed a private helper used by tests.
regen-bot: regendiff: 3 files changed, checksum drift on generated/client.ts (old: b7c11a, new: c2f4e3). Notable edits: ClientOptions field order swapped, _sendWithRetry -> _sendWithBackoff rename, extra overloads regenerated.
sam: That rename could break tests if they import internals (they shouldn't, but...) Also our release gating snapshots compare raw generated code which makes publish hang when cosmetic reorder happens.
raul: Paste minimal diff?
maya: ```diff
- export interface ClientOptions { retry?: boolean; timeout?: number }
+ export interface ClientOptions { timeout?: number; retry?: boolean }
- async function _sendWithRetry(req) { ... }
+ async function _sendWithBackoff(req) { ... }
```
tanya: The field reorder is harmless for TS consumers, but snapshot-based regendiff check flags it as a meaningful change. The private helper rename is the real runtime risk if tests reached in.
sam: Action items: (1) Quick fix to samplekit CI to pin the typegen binary and update tests to not reference private helpers; (2) longer term, make typegen stable-sorted and avoid non-deterministic output; (3) enhance regendiff heuristics to ignore pure-ordering or cosmetic changes.
raul: I'll add a CI grep job to detect private-symbol imports (e.g., _sendWithRetry) across repos so renames fail early.
maya: I've opened PR 412 on samplekit that pins generator and updates the fragile tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/412. Waiting on CI.
regen-bot: Note: regendiff CI will still block if generated artifacts change. Consider an allowlist for whitespace/ordering-only diffs in the gating script.
tanya: On the semver/changelog front: publish gate failed because changelog rules expect a note for public API changes. We need to decide if this is a public contract change or an internal refactor.
maya: My take: treat helper rename as internal (patch). We'll patch tests to avoid internals, pin generator, and release patch. If it actually exposed something public we'll bump minor.
sam: Agreed. I'll push a small hotfix to replace test imports and run through canary.
raul: Longer-term ticket: add deterministic key sorting to typegen output, stabilize helper naming, and make regendiff tolerant of ordering-only diffs. I'll file it and assign to eng-tooling.
maya: Thanks all. Merging PR once green, then we'll revert any accidental renames in the generator repo or formally bump if needed. :thumbsup:
sam: I'll follow up with the test refactor and the grep CI job.
maya: Closing thread after merge.
